title: Large Diffusion Models Need More Than EMA
abstract: arXiv:2610.22945v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large-scale diffusion models are commonly trained with a constant learning rate (LR) and exponential moving average (EMA), despite the strong performance of LR decay and Schedule-Free optimization in training large language models. We study whether EMA is uniquely suited to diffusion training, or whether stronger alternatives have been underexplored. Our theory shows that averaging a constant-step trajectory has an inherent optimization limitation, whereas LR decay and Schedule-Free optimization admit vanishing stationarity guarantees under standard nonconvex assumptions. Empirically, LR decay and EMA provide complementary benefits: combining decay with EMA further improves the standard baseline at most tested starting points, although the gain remains sensitive to when decay begins. translated_title: 大型扩散模型需要的不仅仅是EMA
translated_abstract: 大型扩散模型通常采用恒定学习率（LR）和指数移动平均（EMA）进行训练，尽管学习率衰减和Schedule-Free优化在大型语言模型的训练中已展现出强大的性能。我们研究了EMA是否特别适合扩散模型训练，还是存在被忽视的更强替代方案。我们的理论表明，对恒定步长轨迹进行平均存在固有的优化局限性，而学习率衰减和Schedule-Free优化在标准非凸假设下能够获得趋于消失的平稳性保证。实验证明，学习率衰减和EMA提供了互补的优势：在大多数测试的起始点，将衰减与EMA结合可以进一步提升标准基线的性能，尽管这一增益对衰减开始的时间点较为敏感。Schedule-Free则避免了这一时机要求，并在各个训练阶段持续优于恒定学习率下的EMA，在固定评估计算量和最终模型质量方面均实现了更优的表现。
tldr: 该研究从理论和实验上证明EMA并非扩散模型训练的最优方案：恒定步长轨迹平均存在固有优化局限，而学习率衰减与EMA互补可提升性能，Schedule-Free优化则无需依赖衰减时机即可在各个训练阶段持续超越EMA。
en_tdlr: This study theoretically and empirically demonstrates that EMA is not uniquely suited for diffusion training: constant-step trajectory averaging has inherent optimization limitations, LR decay combined with EMA offers complementary benefits, and Schedule-Free optimization consistently outperforms EMA across training stages without requiring decay timing.
